<Warning>
This integration is developed and maintained by Karamba3D, not Speckle. For support, bug reports, or feature requests, contact [Karamba3D](https://karamba3d.com/) directly.
</Warning>

Karamba3D is a parametric structural analysis tool that allows you to design and analyze 3D trusses, beams, and shells using Grasshopper.

Karamba has developed a v2 Speckle node that wraps the Karamba3D API, allowing you to publish and receive structural analysis models visualizing the real-world appearance of the elements being analyzed.
